Name: Size
Description: Sets the size of the dilation effect. Larger values expand features more, increasing the reach of the dilation.

Name: Shape
Description: Specifies the geometric shape used for the dilation operation, affecting how features are expanded.

Name: Iterations
Description: Controls how many times the dilation process is repeated. More iterations result in greater expansion of features.

Name: Kernel
Description: Selects the kernel type used for dilation, determining the pattern and direction of expansion.

Flubs.Name: Cross
Flubs.Description: Uses a cross-shaped kernel, expanding features in horizontal and vertical directions.

Flubs.Name: Rectangle
Flubs.Description: Uses a rectangular kernel, expanding features uniformly in all directions.

Flubs.Name: Line
Flubs.Description: Uses a line-shaped kernel, expanding features along a specified direction.

Flubs.Name: LineVertical
Flubs.Description: Uses a vertical line kernel, expanding features only in the vertical direction.

Name: Invert
Description: Inverts the input before applying dilation, causing the operation to expand background areas instead of foreground features.
